# Report: household / duplicate / membership code map

Repo: `/home/daniel/sandbox` — Spring PetClinic REST reworked onto **OfficeFloor function injection**. The single relevant write endpoint is `POST /api/owners`, wired in YAML. Build system is **Maven** (`pom.xml`, wrapper `./mvnw`); OfficeFloor starter is `officefloor-rest-spring-boot-4-starter`.

## 1 & 2. Relevant files and code

### householdId generation — `HouseholdId.of(owner)`
`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/HouseholdId.java`

Derives the household id with no stored state: SHA-256 over `normalize(lastName) + ' ' + normalize(address)`, taking the first 8 bytes as 16 upper-case hex chars. `normalize` = trim, collapse whitespace, lower-case.
```java
public static String of(Owner owner) {
    String key = normalize(owner.getLastName()) + ' ' + normalize(owner.getAddress());
    ... SHA-256, first 8 bytes -> 16 uppercase hex chars ...
}
```
Note: the Javadoc references a class `RejectDuplicateOwnerHousehold` that no longer exists (the duplicate check was consolidated into `RejectDuplicateOwnerIdentity`).

### Where householdId is assigned to the DTO — `OwnerMapper`
`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/mapper/OwnerMapper.java` (line 23)
```java
@Mapping(target = "householdId", expression = "java(org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.HouseholdId.of(owner))")
@Mapping(target = "identityKey", expression = "java(org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.IdentityKey.of(owner))")
```
So `householdId` and `identityKey` are computed at mapping time, not stored on the entity.

### identityKey — the value duplicate detection is expressed through
`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/IdentityKey.java`
```java
public static String of(Owner owner) {
    return telephone(owner) + '|' + email(owner) + '|' + HouseholdId.of(owner);
}
// telephone(): E164Telephone.toE164(...) or ""; email(): lower-cased or ""
```

### Duplicate detection / 409 — `RejectDuplicateOwnerIdentity`
`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/RejectDuplicateOwnerIdentity.java`
```java
public void service(@Val Owner owner, OwnerRepository ownerRepository)
        throws DuplicateOwnerIdentityException {
    String telephone = IdentityKey.telephone(owner);
    String email = IdentityKey.email(owner);
    for (Owner other : ownerRepository.findAll()) {
        if (other != owner && telephone.equals(IdentityKey.telephone(other))
                && email.equals(IdentityKey.email(other))) {
            throw new DuplicateOwnerIdentityException(IdentityKey.of(owner));
        }
    }
}
```
Important: despite the `identityKey` including `householdId`, the actual comparison here is **only on normalized telephone + email** — the household component is not part of the reject test. So `sharesHousehold` currently has no effect on the reject (see note in section on sharesHousehold).

Exception + handler + wiring:
